text: The UEBA system flagged this week for CDE1846 due to an unusual surge in file operations, with a volume far outside the distribution of same-role peers. Specifically, Carlos Dieter Ewing performed 13 file operations during this week, which is significantly higher than his typical range of 1-6 and exceeds the maximum value by a factor of almost 2. This unusual activity is the primary evidence supporting the triggered rule, with the Z-score indicating a statistically significant departure from normal behavior.
